prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_catboost', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_catboost emerges as trend champion with perfect correlation (1.0) and best overall RMSE (0.6525), while CWT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.6898). High model disagreement and seasonality variance suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure across the downward trend observed in both validation folds.
